sentences: Over the past decade, thousands of patents have been granted for what are called business methods.
Amazon.com received one for its "one-click" online payment system.
Merrill Lynch got legal protection for an asset allocation strategy.
One inventor patented a technique for lifting a box.
translations: 在过去的十年里，成千上万的所谓商业方法专利被授予。
亚马逊公司因其“一键式”在线支付系统获得了一项专利。
美林公司的一项资产配置策略获得了法律保护。
一位发明家为一种举箱子的技术申请了专利。

sentences: Now the nation's top patent court appears completely ready to scale back on business-method patents, which have been controversial ever since they were first authorized 10 years ago.
In a move that has intellectual-property lawyers abuzz, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit said it would use a particular case to conduct a broad review of business-method patents.
In re Bilski, as the case is known, is "a very big deal," says Dennis D. Crouch of the University of Missouri School of Law.
It "has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents."
translations: 现在，国家最高专利法院似乎完全准备缩减商业方法专利，这些专利自十年前首次授权以来一直备受争议。
在一项令知识产权律师们议论纷纷的举措中，美国联邦巡回上诉法院表示，将利用一个特定案例对商业方法专利进行广泛审查。
密苏里大学法学院的丹尼斯·D·克劳奇说，这个被称为“比尔斯基案”的案件是“一件大事”。
它“有可能消除整个类别的专利”。

sentences: Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic about-face, because it was the Federal Circuit itself that introduced such patents with its 1998 decision in the so-called State Street Bank case, approving a patent on a way of pooling mutual-fund assets.
That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings, initially by emerging Internet companies trying to stake out exclusive rights to specific types of online transactions.
Later, more established companies raced to add such patents to their files, if only as a defensive move against rivals that might beat them to the punch.
In 2005, IBM noted in a court filing that it had been issued more than 300 business-method patents, despite the fact that it questioned the legal basis for granting them.
Similarly, some Wall Street investment firms armed themselves with patents for financial products, even as they took positions in court cases opposing the practice.
translations: 对商业方法专利权利要求进行限制将是一个戏剧性的态度转变，因为正是联邦巡回法院自己在1998年所谓的“道富银行案”判决中引入了此类专利，批准了一种汇集共同基金资产的方法的专利。
该裁决导致了商业方法专利申请的激增，最初是新兴互联网公司试图抢占特定类型在线交易的专有权。
后来，更成熟的公司竞相将这些专利添加到其档案中，即使只是为了防御可能先发制人的竞争对手。
2005年，IBM在一份法庭文件中指出，它已被授予300多项商业方法专利，尽管它质疑授予这些专利的法律依据。
同样，一些华尔街投资公司为金融产品专利武装自己，即使他们在法庭案件中反对这种做法。

sentences: The Bilski case involves a claimed patent on a method for hedging risk in the energy market.

The Federal Circuit issued an unusual order stating that the case would be heard by all 12 of the court's judges, rather than a typical panel of three, and that one issue it wants to evaluate is whether it should "reconsider" its State Street Bank ruling.
translations: 比尔斯基案涉及一项声称的能源市场风险对冲方法专利。
联邦巡回法院发布了一项不寻常的命令，称该案将由法院全部12名法官审理，而不是通常的三名法官小组，并且它想要评估的一个问题是是否应该“重新考虑”其道富银行的裁决。

sentences: The Federal Circuit's action comes in the wake of a series of recent decisions by the Supreme Court that has narrowed the scope of protections for patent holders.
Last April, for example, the justices signaled that too many patents were being upheld for "inventions" that are obvious.
The judges on the Federal Circuit are "reacting to the anti-patent trend at the Supreme Court," says Harold C. Wegner, a patent attorney and professor at George Washington University Law School.
translations: 联邦巡回法院的这一行动是在最高法院最近一系列缩小专利持有人保护范围的裁决之后采取的。
例如，去年四月，法官们表示，有太多显而易见的“发明”专利被维持有效。
乔治华盛顿大学法学院的专利律师兼教授哈罗德·C·韦格纳说，联邦巡回法院的法官们正在“对最高法院的反专利趋势做出反应”。

sentences:
26. Business-method patents have recently aroused concern because of
A. their limited value to businesses
B. their connection with asset allocation
C. the possible restriction on their granting
D. the controversy over their authorization
translations:
26. 商业方法专利最近引起关注是因为
A. 它们对企业的价值有限
B. 它们与资产配置有关
C. 它们的授予可能受到限制
D. 关于它们授权的争议

sentences:
27. Which of the following is true of the Bilski case?
A. Its ruling complies with the court decisions.
B. It involves a very big business transaction.
C. It has been dismissed by the Federal Circuit.
D. It may change the legal practices in the U.S.
translations:
27. 关于比尔斯基案，以下哪项是正确的？
A. 其裁决符合法院的决定。
B. 它涉及一笔非常大的商业交易。
C. 它已被联邦巡回法院驳回。
D. 它可能改变美国的法律实践。

sentences:

B. increase of hostility
C. change of attitude

translations:
28. 单词“about-face”（第3段第1行）最可能的意思是
A. 善意的丧失
B. 敌意的增加
C. 态度的改变
D. 尊严的提升

sentences:
29. We learn from the last two paragraphs that business-method patents
A. are immune to legal challenges
B. are often unnecessarily issued
C. lower the esteem for patent holders
D. increase the incidence of risks

A. 不受法律挑战的影响
B. 经常被不必要地授予
C. 降低了专利持有人的尊严
D. 增加了风险的发生率

sentences:
30. Which of the following would be the subject of the text?
A. A looming threat to business-method patents.
B. Protection for business-method patent holders.
C. A legal case regarding business-method patents.
D. A prevailing trend against business-method patents.
translations:

A. 商业方法专利面临的迫在眉睫的威胁。
B. 对商业方法专利持有人的保护。
C. 一个关于商业方法专利的法律案件。
D. 反对商业方法专利的普遍趋势。
